source_claim: AlphaEvolve's evolutionary database stores generated programs with scores and program outputs so previously explored programs can be resurfaced under fixed search budgets
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests include runtime.history.duplicate_work_policy_report for deterministic workspace-hash grouping, duplicate workspace group counts, run-local evaluation cache stores and hits, cache-hit controller events, evaluator-budget non-consumption for cache hits, and candidate metadata cache status. It does not claim a cross-run workspace hash index, durable evaluation cache storage, resume-spanning cache replay, cache invalidation or migration policy, stochastic re-evaluation policy, semantic near-duplicate detection, source or output aware cache indexes, or an AlphaEvolve-grade fixed-budget memory claim gate.
